# glpi_ip_network (Data Source)

Look up a GLPI IP network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glpi_ip_network" "by_name" {
  name = "example"
}

data "glpi_ip_network" "by_id" {
  id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID. Set id or name.
- `name` (String) Name of the item. Set id or name; must match exactly one item.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Network address, for example 192.168.50.0.
- `addressable` (Boolean) Whether addresses in the network are addressable.
- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `completename` (String) Full path of the item in its tree, computed by GLPI.
- `entity_id` (Number) ID of the entity that owns the item. 0 is the root entity.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway address.
- `ip_version` (Number) IP version, 4 or 6, computed by GLPI.
- `netmask` (String) Netmask, for example 255.255.254.0.
- `parent_id` (Number) ID of the smallest IP network that contains this one, chosen by GLPI from the address. 0 means top level.
